title: E-Commerce Platform

requirements.text: Merchants can create, edit, and delete products (name, description, images, price, SKU, category)
Products are organized into categories that form the browsable storefront structure
Customers browse the catalog by category and view a product detail page with all info and images
Customers can search the catalog by keyword against product names and descriptions
Search results are filterable by category and price range, and sortable by price and newest
Customers add products to a cart that persists across sessions for logged-in users
Customers can update line-item quantity or remove a line item; cart shows a running subtotal
Checkout collects shipping and billing addresses, shows an order summary, and requires authentication; blocked when cart is empty
Shipping cost is calculated from destination address and total order weight and shown at checkout
Payment is processed via Stripe by charging the order total; success marks the order paid, failure shows an error
On successful payment an order record is created capturing line items, addresses, shipping cost, and total
Customers can view order history and per-order status; merchants can view all orders and update status
Each product tracks stock; placing an order decrements stock; zero-stock products are out of stock and not addable to cart
After successful payment, an email receipt is sent to the customer with order number, line items, totals, and shipping address
Customers who purchased a product can leave a 1-5 star rating and written review; product page shows average rating and reviews
Logged-in customers can add/remove products to a wishlist, view it on a dedicated page, and move items into the cart
Merchants use an admin panel (restricted to merchant accounts) for product, category, order, and inventory management

hallucination_traps: Do not add multi-currency support (explicitly out of scope)
Do not add promotions, coupons, or discount codes (explicitly out of scope)
Do not add returns/RMA processing (explicitly out of scope)
Do not invent guest checkout (checkout requires authentication)
Do not invent payment providers other than Stripe
notes: A faithful parser should decompose this into ~15-25 tasks and preserve the stated dependency chain: checkout depends on cart and shipping calculation; payment depends on checkout; order creation depends on payment; inventory decrement and email receipt depend on order creation. Reviews should encode the purchase-gating constraint. Admin panel access is restricted to merchant accounts.
